messages:
maya: Nightly e2e perf gate failed on `main-nightly` — p95 is +42% vs baseline. Jenkins job nightly-e2e-perf #432. Anyone available to do a quick triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: [automated] nightly-e2e-perf #432 finished with status: FAIL. Metric: p95_latency=342ms (baseline=241ms). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/432/logs

derek: on it. Maya, is this the longseq workload or shortseq? Any config changes in the run?

maya: longseq. Config: `--seq-len=2048 --batch=8 --microbatch_window=12ms`. No deliberate changes in test harness. Sample tail of the run:
```
[2026-03-17 02:11:02] request=789 latency=310ms
[2026-03-17 02:11:03] request=790 latency=354ms
[2026-03-17 02:11:04] request=791 latency=330ms
```

jon: we saw a similar p95 spike on canary last night. Suspect is the batching microwindow tweak from PR #248 (author: @suhas). @suhas did that land on main?

suhas: yeah that merged ~3am UTC (commit abc123). It changed microbatch window 8ms -> 12ms to improve throughput. Canary showed higher throughput but I saw a slight p95 bump and marked as noise. Will investigate if this explains the +42%.

maya: can we bisect builds 428..432 to isolate? Derek, can you run a bisect or should I open a ticket?

derek: I can run a quick binary bisect now. Command I'll use:
```
./tools/e2e_bisect.sh --job nightly-e2e-perf --range 428:432 --test longseq --metric p95 --retries 2
```
Expect ~30m. Kicking off.

ci-bot: Rerun requested: nightly-e2e-perf #433 has been queued by @derek. Estimated runtime ~18m.

lina: FYI if bisect points to #248 we should prepare a rollback plan and a short canary revert. I can own the rollout coordination.

jon: throwing one more data point — quick flame trace from a canary run (trimmed):
```
flame: decode_step -> 40%
       attention_kernel -> 25%
       kv_cache_write -> 15%
       io_wait -> 12%
```
That uptick in decode_step aligns with longer microbatching.

suhas: ok if bisect shows PR #248 I can cut a revert PR with a feature flag fallback. Will standby.

ci-bot: bisect job started by @derek: runs launched for builds 428..432. Updates will post in this thread.

[~25 minutes later]

derek: bisect finished. Candidate commit identified: abc123 (PR #248) increased p95 consistently across test runs. Full bisect log: https://ci.redwood/bisect/987/logs

maya: thanks. @suhas can you prepare the revert/fix and we should coordinate a canary once fixed. Lina will coordinate with infra for rollback if needed.

suhas: opening emergency PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/260 — includes revert + flag. I'll request an expedited review.

lina: I'll draft a brief incident note and schedule a canary rollout for the revert once PR merges.

maya: closing the triage here — great quick work. I'll add postmortem tags and link the bisect + logs. :thumbsup:
